name: The Islands
about: Floating islands in endless dark fog, three moons faint through it. The Threshold (where you arrive) with the First Gate north, Ember Wastes east, Crystal Hollow west, the Shattered Keep north, The Dark north-east and Magma Falls south-west, joined by basalt bridges lit with fire; the Pale Door on the plaza leads back to the void. Made by tools/assets/build_islands.py.
